notes.title: Game update on May 6, 2023
notes.content:
Dear friends, here are the updates for this version:

1、The protagonist’s skins have been reset and beautified.

2、Fixed the bug where the protagonist could move and then get stuck during the purification ritual at the Altar of Revenge.

3、Fixed the bug where some enemies in the Revenge Road would slide when sitting down.

4、Strengthened the attack benefits of the tiger and bear forms. Now, when players successfully counterattack, it will recover some stamina.

5、Fixed the bug where the arrow would remain in the hand when switching weapons in certain situations.

6、Added the feature where the enemy’s health bar will automatically hide when they are too far away from the protagonist.

7、Added playable plot events that can be triggered in every level of Rescue Road. Each event will unlock a new Sword Bestowal skill.

8、Added the feature to use Enhancement Vouchers to increase the maximum enhancement limit of clothing in the enhancement interface.

9、Removed the boss in the Heart Demon level, which was very boring. Also optimized the issue where the Heart Demon could spawn in an unreachable location.

10、Added visual camera movements for actions such as counterattacks and assassinations. Also removed the restriction of not being able to open the camera mode.

11、Fixed the bug where the protagonist’s jaw position would stretch and deform in some events.

I will continue to update the game. Thank you for your support and love for the princess.

notes.title: Game update on November 14, 2022
Update on 2022-11-12
notes.content:
Assassination is an action with high risk and high return. It can only be used once to deal with one enemy. In the last update, the benefits of assassination were too low. "Gently stabbing you" is a unique style of play, which should have allowed people who like this action to get more returns. Therefore:



This small update has greatly enhanced the assassination gains, and greatly reduced the rigidity time of assassination operations. BOSS enemies can also be assassinated.

notes.title: Game update on November 12, 2022
notes.content:
Hello dear players, the content of this update is as follows:



1: Fixed a problem with the character's feet deforming when triggering some events.



2: In the triggering process of some events, the function of whether clothing is displayed is added.



3: A non GROOM particle hairstyle is added to save performance.



4: Fixed the problem that some GROOM particle hair looks bald with sparse head.



5: Improved the enemy's response AI on the road of revenge, and optimized the performance of CPU computing occupied by AI.Redo the visual effect of blood splash when attacking enemies.



6: The original 12 levels of “Road of salvation” were reduced to 10 levels. (The stone falling level is neither profitable nor fun, so it is removed) (Assassination should be a means rather than a game purpose, so the assassination level is removed)



7: The clothing store has added a tab for clothing categories, and the currently selected category identification has been added to all the interfaces where categories can be switched.



8: The sign of currently wearing clothes has been added to the clothing backpack and enhancement interface.



 9: The original design of the game was to use different clothes through their appearance attributes. In the previous version, this idea was completely blurred. So now the clothing attributes have been redone and the clothing enhancement function has been moved to the main menu. 



 10: The main game targets have been added to Revenge Road, and a new  area of Revenge Road has also been added. This is a new place of birth. Its main function is to carry many more NPC interactive content now and in the future. 



 11: In the previous version, the charm system has completely collapsed it lost the significance of various charm combinations. Therefore, the charm system has been redesigned in this upgrade,lets try different combinations to get different game experiences. 



12: The main menu tasks information of all maps are changed to a map display, which will provide the identification of enemies and target task points.



13: Modified the allocation method of attribute points after upgrade.



14: In order to strengthen the integrity of the game, an plot show was added when the “Road of salvation” was completed.



15: Some useless skills or skills that may cause serious balance problems have been deleted. In this version, only 5 sword skills have been retained. However, please note that the sword skills are still in the initial stage. In my idea, using sword skills will be closer to the sense of super magic. They may produce huge and cool big actions. At present, only a few small skills can be used.



 16: In order to distinguish the use of different attack postures and the game experience it brings, this update has redesigned the attack postures system. Now, the eight postures have completely different effects. (For example, the wolf postures have been changed to long-range attacks,yes,it is a bow, and now the postures system is still not complete. For example, a certain posture should be replaced by an attack using a fist, and the postures should have different assassinations and counterattacks.)





 The most important thing is that this update actually includes many NPCs and their interactions, but you can't trigger them in recent few days. I will add updates frequently later to gradually open these NPC interaction content. 




 Important note: after this update, the original save archive will not be compatible. It is recommended that you may need to save the character appearance data in this path to other place before you launch the new version of game.And replace it after you finish the charactor creat(C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\WSgames\Saved\SaveGames\SaveCharactor1. sav)

notes.title: Emperor's new patch
notes.content:
In the main version update, the emperor's new clothes were obtained as the same as other clothes by killing the enemy or reward, but after one night sleeping, I realized that when the player killed the enemy and obtained a new dress, which is the emperor's new dress, it means that the player didn't get anything and occupied an opportunity to obtain a new dress, which is very unreasonable.



Therefore, the emperor's new clothes will be automatically given in the camp if the player does not get them.

notes.title: January 24, 2022 corrective update
notes.content:
Update Description:

1: Fixed the bug that the princess diary may block the button in the "map selection" interface

2: Reduces the oily luster of the protagonist's skin and fixes the problem that the protagonist's skin will turn yellow under some kind of lights

3: Fixed the detection bug of the condition of the "heart demon" map. Now  correct prompt of overcome a certain heart demon

4: Fixed a bug in the "heart demon" map that some heart demons could not be correctly killed before contacting the protagonist

5: Deleted the drowning death judgment of the princess (now the protagonist will walk under the water and will not die, but I will correctly join the swimming system in the future)

6: It reduces the time that gold coins can be picked up after falling, and increases the picking range of gold coins (this is a temporary solution. It should be a better solution to automatically adsorb gold coins to the protagonist in the future)

7: Fixed the problem of directly returning to the main menu after death. Now it will return to the camp

8: The removal of shoes is added in the princess's wardrobe (the stockings will not match the feet when the shoes are not worn, so don't take on the stockings without shoes. I will try to solve this problem in the future)

9: Fixed the problem that the dark part of some levels may be too dark

10: Deleted a messy and problematic hairstyle


Special note: I have no intention to remove the training system. The training and growth system will return in future versions. At the same time, the clothing will continue to increase with each update.

notes.title: July 17 game optimization and update
notes.content:
The content of this update is as follows:

1. Greatly optimize the frame rate, FPS of all levels and scenes are improved by 5-20 frames

2. The picture quality has been further improved

3. Fixed support for depth of field, especially for photographing

4. Add 10 groups of pose, and redo all the original pose, no longer using situational action

5. The camera position adjustment function is added in the photographing mode. Press and hold the middle mouse button to drag the lens position

6. The birth level has been modified to make it easier for players to find swords, and changed from night to day

7. Move the prompt NPC of the first level to the birth level, and redo the weather of the first level, no longer starting with the dark environment

After this update, the game will be more fluent, and taking better photos will become a very simple thing.

Thank you.
From P&B

notes.title: Game update on July 14
notes.content:
The contents of this update are as follows:

1: The loading time of all levels has been optimized, it has been greatly reduced

2: The picture rendering speed of all levels has been optimized. Now, even if it runs on a computer with a lower FPS, the picture will be rendered smoothly without sudden jamming

3: The combat system has been upgraded again, including the following improvements:

a: Now when the player attacks, even if unlocked, actor will automatically face the nearest enemy

b: The protagonist can now make more combos, which include two heavy attacks. Heavy attacks can directly damage the enemy blocking with shield

c: Enhanced basic AI, the enemy will now dodge the player's attack. If the player's attack gives the enemy enough reaction time, the enemy will dodge

d: Add the mechanism that players will appear bounced when attacking. When players are attacking, if the enemy is also attacking, according to the weapon distance of both sides, the attacks of both sides may be bounced away

e: Because of the burst fire skill can't move when cast, it slightly increases the damage range

f: A cucumber has been added. Players can have a cucumber to eat once every level. It will supplement half of health

4: Bug repair:

a: Fixed the bug that the boss's kick in the third level would make the player unable to get up. Now the player has enough time to get up

b: Fixed a bug that some ordinary enemies would attack the player with their back when they were close to the player

notes.title: Important update on July 12
notes.content:
In combination with the original design plan of the game and with full reference to the suggestions of the comment area, an important update has been made to the game in the current version, as follows:

1. The combat action and combo have been updated, from the original 3 combo to 5 combo, and replaced with more agile and easy to control attack action.

2. An attack mode that can be moved during the attack is added, which can be switched from the continuous attack mode by using the key

3. A variety of clothing additional skills have been added. Players can add abilities to each clothes once in the wardrobe interface. The abilities obtained to each clothes is random, but once it is added, the corresponding abilities of the garment will be fixed, each ability is very powerful, This will strongly affect the protagonist put on this dress when the game fighting way.

4. Remove the original damage clothing skill from the base game, it will not affect the game experience, because it will reappear in the form of free DLC.

5. The most frequently loaded campsite level in the game process is optimized, which greatly shortens the loading time when opening the campsite level, and the loading optimization of other levels will be updated one after another.

6. After the player dies, click continue to move from the main interface to the camp.

7. Slightly increased the protagonist's strength consumption, the current degree of strength consumption whether it is reasonable is still under investigation.

8. Corresponding to the game changes, the interface and teaching text are updated.

At the beginning of the development of this game, it was planned to combine clothing and skills, it's also led to the lack of clothing skills in the previous  version, which made the battle monotonous. This skill update is just the beginning. In the future, the number and details of clothing, as well as the type and number of additional skills will continue to increase.

（Please note: after this update, the original game archive will not be available）

In the next major version update, the plan mainly has three directions:

1: Along with the current story, continues to add the levels

2: Increase and improve the types of enemies and AI

3: Optimization of game graphics, level loading and UI interface

Thanks!
From:P&B

notes.title: Game update on July 8 2021
notes.content:
After seriously read the comments in the comments area, the following is the upgrade instructions made on July 8:

1: The game screen setting menu has been adjusted, the gamma value adjustment option has been added, and the resolution modification option has been added.
(some players reported that the game screen is dark, which may be caused by the quality of effects settings. Therefore, an explanation is added under the effects settings, and the gamma settings are added to provide further improvement.)

2: Limit monsters so that they can't fall out of the map to avoid the problem that players can't kill monsters.
(this is only a temporary solution. A better solution is that the monster will be hurt if it falls down. If it falls to death, there will be no such problem. I plan to finish in the next update)

3: In order to take care of the habits of some players, the function of y-axis reversal is added.

4: Some of the more open level maps increase roads and reduce the possibility of getting lost.

5: Some players feel that the attack action is too slow and not comfortable, so the attack speed of the protagonist has been increased. Now it's much more refreshing to chop. Correspondingly, the crystal required for each new dress has been increased from 100 to 200.

6: The prompt of game archiving has been added. Whenever an archiving event occurs, the prompt of successful archiving will be displayed in the upper left corner.

Conclusion: the setup menu of the whole game is not perfect at present. I plan to redesign the GUI completely. Therefore, many improvements will be made in a relatively fast and effective way at this stage. When the GUI design is down, I believe many problems can be well solved through setup.

Thank you very much for your valuable suggestions and feedback.
